scope: Read-only pinned source/header inspection to narrow a future diagnostic; no GPU probe, code fix or causal result.
source_bounds: Bound-buffer retain logic already exists in the stable core; it is not itself a newly introduced change.
The Max-device vector2pass block-count heuristic is identical old/new. Changing MLX_SDPA_BLOCKS could be tuning, not evidence of a new block-count regression.
Generic vector2pass gained TK4 prefetch; BF16 D256 has a TK1 fallback when required threadgroup exceeds kernel limits. Header dtype does not prove the actual selected runtime kernel.
Non-NAX full attention D256 changes wn1 to wn2; this is a relevant prefill-path difference, not a proven cause.
Command-buffer accounting changes data_size to data_size*itemsize, with scoped g13s>=24GiB200MiB batching; retain correct accounting and safety/fence fixes.

reuse.note: Existing upstream operator benchmark defaults/hardcodes FP16 and logical itemsize2. Reuse/adapt it for pinned BF16 D256/GQA8 rather than inventing an unrelated benchmark; preserve raw samples and numerical reference. The PR body names a different filename, so use the actual committed path.

next: After live20319 is terminal, verify actual attention dtype/dispatch and choose a bounded operator diagnostic before any production patch. Test candidates with identical shapes/precision and numerical reference; a microbenchmark alone cannot promote a release.
